thread:
alex: Heads-up — support ticket #1482: multiple customers reporting 503s on hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. Metrics show a spike in upstream runner exits (SIGSEGV) on embed-heavy routes.

sre-oncall: I'm pulling logs now. Which pools/regions impacted? Any recent deploys?

maria: Seeing it primarily on pool-hosted-eu-3 and hosted-us-west-2-pool2. Endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings. Memory climbs to full then containers exit. Sample from container stdout:
```
runtime: inference-runner v0.9.7
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] ERROR: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8c2b1a3f
stack: libtorch.so+0x1a2b3c libkv_prefetch.so+0x4f2d
GPU(0) mem: 24.5G/24.5G (99%)
May 17 09:12:34 host inference-runner[pid] core dumped
```

sam: We rolled quant-llama2-q8 to hosted-eu-3 last night at 04:00 UTC (auto-canary). Could be a quant/torch kernel mismatch. I also see increased batch sizes on embeddings (dynbatch tweak yesterday).

jess: Repro suggestion: smallest repro that triggered it was a synthetic workload: 50 concurrent embedding requests with ctx_size ~512, batching window 12ms. Curl repro (non-prod):
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TESTKEY\" \
    -d '{"model":"quant-llama2-q8","input":"test test"}' &
done
wait
```

support-bot: Ticket #1482 created: https://support.example/tickets/1482 — affected customers: acme, pulseai. SLA risk flagged.

alex: Impact numbers: 503 rate for hosted inference rose from 0.1% -> 3.7% over the past 40m. P95 latency for embeddings also increased from 140ms -> 1.2s. Customers seeing timeouts and retries.

sre-oncall: Mitigation plan (proposed):
1) Drain hosted-eu-3 from embedding traffic (route to hosted-eu-2 fallback).
2) Roll back quant-llama2-q8 from pool if metrics don't stabilize within 10m.
3) Collect coredumps & gdb backtrace, grab /var/log/inference-runner/core.* and nvcrash logs.

Commands to route traffic (infra CLI):
```bash
infra route set --from pool=hosted-eu-3 --to pool=hosted-eu-2 --policy=embeddings --weight=100
infra pool drain --pool hosted-eu-3 --grace 120
```

maria: Also capturing heap profiles and KV cache stats. I suspect a leak in kvcache prefetch: resident set grows per-request until OOM. Collecting /metrics/kvcache and `pmap` snapshots. Will attach memory flamegraphs to the ticket.

sam: FYI we've got a hotfix branch (fix/kvcache-bounds-check) that addresses an off-by-one in the prefetch path; QA ran basic checks but not full stress under quant models. We can promote a canary to eu-2 quickly if needed.

jess: Action items/owners:
- alex: coordinate rollback & customer comms (owner)
- sre-oncall: execute routing + drain (owner)
- maria: collect coredump/gdb/heapprof and attach to ticket (owner)
- sam: prepare hotfix artifact and canary (owner)
- jess: update status page and CS playbook (owner)
Timeline: start mitigations immediately, 15m check-in, escalate to infra kernel team if crashes persist.

alex: Starting drain now, switching traffic to hosted-eu-2. Posting updates to ticket and status page. cc @maria @sam.

sre-oncall: Drain issued, traffic shifting. Will monitor 503 rate & GPU mem curves. If p95 doesn't drop below 300ms in 10m, initiate rollback of quant-llama2-q8.

maria: Uploading coredump + initial gdb bt (attached to #1482). GDB snippet: 
```
#0  0x00007f8c2b1a3f in torch::native::...
#1  0x00007f8c2c4a1b in kvcache::prefetch::read_batch
#2  0x000055aa1e3f in inference::runner::handle_request
```
Pointers look corrupted in prefetch read path.

sam: Can confirm hotfix compiles against our internal libtorch 2.1.3-cuda12.1 build. I'll push canary to hosted-eu-2 in ~8m, but if rollback is needed we should prefer revert to previous model binary.

jess: Noted customer comms: will post interim status: \"Investigating increased 503s on embeddings endpoint; traffic is being routed to fallback pools. Engineers are collecting diagnostics.\"

alex: Update 09:28 UTC — after drain and routing, 503 rate dropped to 0.6%, p95 down to 220ms. Keeping monitoring. Will proceed with deeper repro in staging using same dynbatch params.

sre-oncall: Keep logs and core dumps retained (72h) and tag with INCIDENT-1482. If we confirm crash root cause in kvcache, prepare a postmortem with timeline + fix plan. :white_check_mark:

maria: Staging repro succeeded with quant model + dynbatch stress — reproduced segfault locally. Collecting exact minimal repro to include in PR.

sam: Starting hotfix rollout plan: canary on eu-2, then gradual to eu-3 after verification. If anything abnormal -> immediate rollback.

jess: Thanks all — I'll run the CS status thread and update affected customers. Keep updates short and include next check-in time.

alex: Closing thread for now while we monitor; will reopen if regression. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
